name.zh: LLaMA-Factory 检查点反序列化 RCE

description: LLaMA-Factory v1 resume path restores rng_state and dataloader state with explicit torch.load(weights_only=False); whoever can write the checkpoint directory gets pickle code execution on resume. Verified at function level against the pinned llamafactory 0.9.5 wheel (venv-lfa).

params_schema.target: checkpoint directory or dataset cache path (read-only proof)
params_schema.snapshot: snapshot JSON path or dict (read-only modules)
params_schema.backup_targets: backup target list for the runner backup gate
